name: Amelie Earhart
source: Amelie has never had an outstanding talent for magic, but she has been fascinated by the wizarding world's history since childhood. She loves books and smart people more than anything else in the world. After graduating from Cordale, she took a job as a local librarian to be able to study the rarest magical writings and folios in the world.
